isabel: Quick sync  SableWorks signed off on a short case profile + 30m interview next Wed 10:00am PT. Need legal on quote clearance, logo permission, and an embargo window. Also want registrants routed to SDR queue 'sableworks-webinar'.

rory: I'll run recording and ask for separate takes for social clips. Will put a consent checkbox and a short release link on the invite.

courtney: Paste the verbatim candidate lines so I can pre-check compliance. If they quote percentages, we'll need a metrics snapshot or written confirmation. Logo usage requires a signed logo release.

isabel: Verbatim lines from the customer call (they'll repeat on mic):
```
"After moving to Redwood Dedicated our P95 dropped from ~340ms to ~200ms at peak."
"Batching + KV cache cut GPU spend on conversation flows by roughly 39% during the pilot."
"Rollout was low-friction  ops hit SLA targets without extra cycles."
```

rory: I'll capture each line as separate soundbites. Also will request a short written confirmation of the percent so legal can clear it.

courtney: If we can't get the snapshot, we'll switch public copy to 'meaningful reduction' and include exact numbers in a gated appendix. I can draft the one-paragraph release and a redaction checklist today. Requested embargo?

isabel: Customer requested earliest publish 2026-12-08 08:00 PT. They need final copy by 12/03 EOD to sign the release.

nina: For lead routing, sample webhook payload (auth omitted):
```
POST /hooks/sfdc HTTP/1.1
Host: hooks.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "source": "sableworks-webinar",
  "email": "{registrant_email}",
  "first_name": "{registrant_first}",
  "last_name": "{registrant_last}",
  "utm_campaign": "sableworks-launch",
  "target_queue": "SableWorks Webinar"
}
```

rory: Invite created and recording enabled. I'll upload raw video + transcript and tag timestamps for approved soundbites. ops-bot: attach release template to event please.

ops-bot: Calendar invite "SableWorks case interview" created by rory for 2026-12-02 10:00 PT. Reminder: attach release template https://drive.google.com/fake-link/sable-release

isabel: Thanks  checklist for playbook: legal sign-off (courtney), release signed (rory), landing page + webhook test (nina), assets uploaded (rory). Ping when each is done. :rocket:
